name: Novelty is the successor Tier-2 inflation driver
description: After the May TCH/SCP always-on gate was closed, NOV>=3 became the mechanism escalating ~46% of daily posts to Tier 2. 11 of 12 June Tier-2 posts carried NOV>=3; only 1 was a bare TCH/SCP-floor escalation. All 11 classifier-vs-structural-grader disagreements were one-directional (classifier higher).
conditions: Post scores NOV>=3 but NAR<=2 and RPR<=2 (novelty is the sole subjective escalator); routine operational/CI/gate/healthcheck subject matter.
evidence: June 2026: Tier1 45.8% (below 60-70% floor), Tier2 50.0% (above 25-35%); NOV>=3 on 11/12 Tier-2 posts; novelty-cap anti-inflation flag fired only 1x despite being the dominant escalator; Brier 0.3782 with 11/11 one-directional over-tier disagreements vs structural grader.
retired_reason: superseded by auto-2026-07-001 (operative form); documentation-only, never applied

name: Tier-2 narrative-or-standout floor
description: A Tier-2 Deep-Dive requires NAR>=3 (genuine narrative) OR at least one dimension>=4 (a standout). A flat wall of 3s (NAR<=2, nothing>=4) is Tier 1. Operative realization of auto-2026-06-001: simulation showed the novelty-sole-escalator condition never fired retroactively because the real inflation ran through NOV>=3 + a borderline TCH=3 on flat-narrative ops/CI/governance work.
evidence: July 2026 tier-creep calibration: T2 stuck ~50% Jun-Jul (target 25-35%), Brier 0.378 Jun-onward. Simulated on 167 historical decisions: downgrades 4 flat-narrative posts; June T2 50%->38% / T1 46%->58%; last-30 T2 53%->43%; preserves all NAR>=3-or-dim>=4 posts; no Jan/Feb over-deflation.
retired_reason: superseded by auto-2026-08-001. Fired ZERO times in July 2026 (all 14 pattern-engine records logged applied_patterns=[]; simulated over all 35 July decisions it fires 0x). The nar<=2 clause was routed around by anchor drift: NAR<=2 held on 16/24 June posts but only 8/35 July posts, and the ARC/NAR/TCH >=4 award rate roughly tripled, defeating max_all<=3 as well. Calibrated on June's score distribution; July's distribution moved out from under both clauses within 4 weeks of adoption.

name: Tier-2 standout floor (drift-resistant form)
description: A Tier-2 Deep-Dive requires at least one dimension >=4 (a genuine standout). A flat wall of 3s is Tier 1 REGARDLESS of NAR. This is auto-2026-07-001 with the nar<=2 clause REMOVED -- that clause is exactly what July's anchor drift routed around (NAR<=2 held on 16/24 June posts but only 8/35 July posts), so the rule silently stopped binding while reporting applied_patterns=[], which reads identically to 'nothing needed downgrading'.
conditions: tier>=2 AND at least 2 dims >=3 AND max(NOV,ARC,NAR,TCH,SCP,RPR)<=3 -- no dimension reaches standout, so no Deep-Dive claim. The count_ge3>=2 clause is a REQUIRED GUARD, not a scoring criterion: apply-patterns.py features() defaults every absent dimension to 0, so a bare max_all<=3 rule matches the 80 corpus records that carry no dimensions block at all and would spuriously cap them to Tier 1. count_ge3>=2 is false for an all-zeros record and true for any genuine flat-wall-of-3s post (verified: 2026-07-05 has count_ge3==2). auto-2026-07-001 was shielded from this by accident via the same clause.
evidence: July 2026 full-month calibration: T1 17.1% / T2 68.6% / T3 14.3% (targets 60-70 / 25-35 / 5-10); Brier 0.5524 as graded, 0.2609 vs structural. Simulated on all 199 historical classifier decisions: 11 downgrades. Apr 36/36/27 unchanged; May T2 61.9->52.4; Jun T2 50.0->33.3 (T1 45.8->62.5); Jul T2 68.6->65.7 (T1 17.1->20.0). Every month moves toward band, no month pushed out of one (T2 floor >=25% in all four; T1 never above 70%). Catches 2026-07-05 (NOV2 ARC2 NAR3 TCH3 SCP2 RPR2, shipped Tier 2). NOTE: this is a strict improvement, NOT a fix for July -- no score-keyed cap rule fixes July, because the drift is in the anchors the rule reads. The real fix is >=4 anchor recalibration plus a deterministic tier<->length gate (calibration-2026-07.md recs 2 and 3). COUNTING CAVEAT: times_applied=25 is the RULE-MATCH count reported by apply-patterns.py backfill, which counts every decision whose features satisfy the rule including Tier-1 records where cap_tier(1) is a no-op. Effective downgrades (tier>=2 -> 1) are 11.
supersedes: auto-2026-07-001 (nar<=2 clause removed; that clause was defeated by anchor drift)
